question: Which of the following dance forms is influenced by Bihu dance?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sattriya.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ​The** 15th century A.D.** saw the introduction of the **Sattriya dance style**.
 
• **Mahapurusha Sankaradeva, **a revered Assamese **Vaishnava saint and reformer,** introduced it.
 
• It served as a** potent tool** for the spread of the **Vaishnava religion.​**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **Manipuri dance:**

 
 
• One of the nine** principal Indian classical dance** styles is the Manipuri Dance.
 
• It was created in the **Manipur state.**
 
• **The Radha-Krishna Madhura Raas's spiritual **elements are infused throughout the dance.
 
 
 
• **Kathak dance:**
 
 
• One of the nine primary styles of** Indian classical dance** is kathak.
 
• It is** Uttar Pradesh's traditional style** of dance.
 
 
 
• **Kuchipudi dance:**
 
 
• One of the** nine principal classical dances** of India is called Kuchipudi.
 
• It comes from the **Andhra Pradesh** state of India, specifically the village of** Kuchipudi.**
